title: FilmDrop UI config.json
description: Runtime configuration consumed by FilmDropRoot via configUrl. See config_helper/ in the repository for full examples.

PUBLIC_URL.description: Absolute or relative URL prefix for branding assets (logo, favicon).

LOGO_URL.description: URL for the primary header logo. Resolved relative to configUrl base when library-embedded.

APP_NAME.description: Document.title source when applyDocumentBranding is true.

APP_FAVICON.description: Favicon asset name served from the configUrl base.

BRAND_LOGO.description: Light/dark brand logo. String for a single asset; object of the form {"light": "...", "dark": "..."}.

COLLECTIONS.description: Collection id defaults and per-collection configuration.

STAC_API_URL.description: Root STAC API endpoint used for search, collections, aggregations, queryables.

APP_TOKEN_AUTH_ENABLED.description: When true, the Login flow gates access until a JWT is persisted to localStorage under APP_AUTH_TOKEN.

SCENE_TILER_PARAMS.description: Per-collection TiTiler query parameters (assets, color_formula, colormap_name, rescale, ...).

DEFAULT_TILE_LAYER.description: Default Leaflet TileLayer configuration (url, attribution, minZoom, maxZoom, ...).

DEFAULT_AOI.description: Default bounding box / GeoJSON used on initial load.

RESERVED_PARAMS.description: Reserved URL search params owned by FilmDrop. Consumers must not stomp on: dt, view, viz, tab, z, c.

$comment: Additional fields are allowed; FilmDrop's applyConfigDefaults() merges this document with built-in defaults (see src/constants/defaults.js). Legacy formats are preserved — see config_helper/config.example.json for historical examples.
